The '''lepton numbers''', denoted by $\mathrm{L_e, L_\mu, L_\tau}$, is a [[conserved property]] in [[quantum particle interaction]]s.<ref>{{#cite:Q2527}}</ref>

There are three lepton numbers:<ref>{{#cite:Q2527}}</ref>

* $L_e$, the electron-lepton number,
* $L_\mu$, the muon-lepton number,
* $L_\tau$, the tau-lepton number.
